note: Both sets share significant errors, including an invented maximum tangential force of 900 N/m (graph axis max is 800 N/m) and contradictory normal force values for U=6 m/s (4000 vs 4200 N/m). Set B is preferred because it uses more standard entity names ('rotor' instead of the verbose caption text 'CCBlade steady-state blade element momentum') and has slightly fewer duplicate claims for the same facts. Set B also includes a more accurate estimate for the maximum normal force at U=10 m/s (10500 N/m) compared to Set A's 11000 N/m, although Set B inconsistently includes the 11000 N/m claim elsewhere.
remarks: Both sets fail to correctly read the Tangential Force axis limit (800 N/m), claiming 900 N/m. Both sets contradict themselves on the U=6 m/s Normal Force (4000 vs 4200 N/m). Set A's entity extraction is overly verbose.
